title: Pulsar APX Portable Vaporizer V2 (taxes extra)
description:
PHASED OUT

REPLACED BY PULSAR APX V3
PULSAR APX PRO ALSO AVAILABLE

The Pulsar APX V2 Vaporizer offers a compact portable palm-sized vapes at a price everyone can afford.

A faster 30-second heat time, haptic feedback, enhanced LED display, ergonomic mouthpiece, silicone mouthpiece insert, 10x16mm ceramic chamber, finely tuned temperature settings, and more!

Best of all- there are multiple designs to match your cool.

Recommended for new to vaporizing and light users. For an entry level herbal vaporizer, the Pulsar APX V2 does a great job. For medium to heavy users, consider other vaporizers.

Features:
• 4″ dry herb vaporizer
• 30-second heat time
• Improved silicone cooling system
• Multiple designs & colors
• Haptic feedback when ready
• Enhanced LED display
• Improved mouthpiece (V374MP)
• 10x16mm ceramic chamber
• Finely tuned heat settings
• Temperature range from 356°F – 428°F
